```
(Curr ently Amended) Claim 1: A computing device for mapping user movements captured by a capture device external to the computing device, to inputs events on the computing device, the computing device comprising: a display to display an application executing on the computing device; a client sharing module to: transmit video data of the application to a receiver device; and receive gesture data associated with the application, the gesture data based on movements of a user captured from a capture device communicatively coupled to the receiver device; and a mapping module to: map the gesture data into an input event on the computing device; and provide data simulating the input event to a sensor of the computing device, wherein the client sharing module is to establish a video channel between the computing device and the receiver device to facilitate the transmission of the video data.

(Curr ently Amended) Claim 5: The computing device of claim 1, wherein the client sharing module is to: establish a video channel between the computing device and receiver device; establish an input channel between the computing device and receiver device; and wherein the video data is transmitted over the video channel and gesture data is received via the input channel.

(Curr ently Amended) Claim 2: The computing device of claim 1, wherein to map the gesture data into an input event on the computing device, the mapping module is to: retrieve a type of movement of the user from the gesture data; and determine the input event based on the type of movement, wherein the input event is an action triggered by the application executing on the computing device.

(Curr ently Amended) Claim 3: The computing device of claim 2, wherein when the type of movement of the user is a swipe movement the gesture data is mapped to a touch input event and data simulating the touch input event is provided to a touch sensor of the computing device, wherein the swipe movement is recognized and processed by the mapping module.

(Curr ently Amended) Claim 4: The computing device of claim 2, wherein when the type of movement of the user is a lean movement the gesture data is mapped to a rotate input event and data simulating the rotate input event is provided to a gyroscope of the computing device, wherein the lean movement is indicative of an interaction with the application.

(Curr ently Amended) Claim 10: A method of mapping user movements captured by a capture device external to a computing device, to inputs events on the computing device, the method comprising: executing an application on the computing device, using at least one processor of the computing device; transmitting, from the computing device, video data of the application to a receiver device via a video channel; receiving, at the computing device from the receiver device, gesture data associated with the application, the gesture data based on movements of a user captured from a capture device communicatively coupled to the receiver device; mapping the gesture data to an input event on the computing device; and providing data simulating the input event to a sensor on the computing device.

(Curr ently Amended) Claim 11: The method of claim 10, wherein mapping the gesture data into an input event on the computing device comprises: retrieving a type of movement of the user from the gesture data; and determining the input event based on the type of movement, wherein the input event is an action triggered by the application executing on the computing device.

(Curr ently Amended) Claim 12: The method of claim 11, wherein mapping the gesture data into an input event further comprises: mapping the gesture data to a touch input event when the type of movement is a swipe movement, wherein the touch input event modifies the application interface.

(Curr ently Amended) Claim 14: The method of claim 11, wherein mapping the gesture data into an input event further comprises: mapping the gesture data to a rotate input event when the type of movement is a lean movement, wherein the rotate input event modifies the application display based on user interaction.

(Curr ently Amended) Claim 16: The method of claim 10, further comprising: establishing a video channel between the computing device and receiver device; establishing an input channel between the computing device and the receiver device; and wherein the video data is transmitted over the video channel and gesture data is received via the input channel.

(Curr ently Amended) Claim 19: The method of claim 10, further comprising: transmitting updated video data to the receiver device based on the application updating in response to the input event, wherein the updated video data reflects real-time changes in the application display.

(Curr ently Amended) Claim 20: At least one machine-readable storage medium including instructions for mapping user movements captured by a capture device external to a computing device to inputs events on the computing device, which when executed by a machine, cause the machine to perform operations comprising: executing an application on the computing device; transmitting, from the computing device, video data of the application to a receiver device via a video channel; receiving, at the computing device from the receiver device, gesture data associated with the application, the gesture data based on movements of a user captured from a capture device communicatively coupled to the receiver device; mapping the gesture data to an input event on the computing device; and providing data simulating the input event to a sensor on the computing device.
```
